name: Destination Egypt: Studio location intelligence
use: Reusable creative intelligence for Studio ideas, concepts, briefs and proposals. A location is suggested only for the project types listed. Every access, permit, venue or date is 'to verify' until NOYA has it in writing; Studio never promises it.
rules: Never promise a permit, a closure, a private opening or exclusive access that has not been confirmed in writing.
Commercial, documentary, TV and cinematic filming needs permits; personal photography at sites does not. Write 'filming permits to be arranged' and never 'permitted'.
Every shoot at or near a historic site may need a Supreme Council of Antiquities inspector on set; budget and schedule for it.
Drones are regulated by a dedicated law with permits through the Ministry of Defence; treat any drone shot as subject to approval and never include it in a cold idea.
Hosting (FAM trips, recces, previews) is never offered in cold outreach and never free by default; any complimentary element needs Adam's approval.

filming_at_sites.known: The Supreme Council of Antiquities approved controls for commercial, advertising and cinematic photography at museums and archaeological sites (August 2021). Cabinet rules (2022) keep permits for cinema, TV, documentary and commercial filming; personal photography in public places needs none.
filming_at_sites.status: TO_VERIFY per project: current fee schedule, application route and lead time are not confirmed.

drones.known: Regulated by a dedicated law; applications go through the Ministry of Defence and silence after thirty days counts as refusal.
drones.status: TO_VERIFY: assume no drone footage unless approved in writing.
